Annaprasan Decoration Kit (54 Pieces) - Baby Rice Ceremony Set

This Annaprasan decoration kit includes red and gold colour metallic balloons, a printed Annaprasan banner, heart foil balloons and themed props for your baby's first rice ceremony. Suitable for home celebrations, family gatherings and photo backdrops.

The included pump, arch tape, glue dot strip and LED light help you assemble the decoration with the supplied items.

 What You Get (54 Pieces)
1 Annaprasan Banner
20 Red Metallic Balloons
20 Gold Metallic Balloons
8 Heart Foil Balloons
1 Pump
1 LED Light 10 mtr
1 Arch Tape
1 Glue Dote Stripe
1 Annaprasan With Props Kit Complete

 Key Features
 Metallic Balloons - Red and gold colour theme
 Heart Foils - Ceremony backdrop
 Banner - Printed Annaprasan design
 LED Light - Wall decoration
 Setup Items - Pump tape and glue included

 Perfect For
Annaprasan Ceremony
Baby First Rice Ceremony
Mukhe Bhaat
Home Celebration
Family Photos

 Why Choose This Kit?

Includes decoration items and setup accessories in one pack.

 Arrange the balloons banner props and LED light to create the ceremony backdrop.
